items.title: Meta announces Muse personal AI agent in the UK
items.summary_en: An official Meta newsroom post titled 'Introducing Muse in the UK: A Personal AI Agent You Control' indicates Meta is extending its Muse personal AI agent to UK users. Only the title and URL slug were visible in search results; the body could not be read.
items.notes: WebFetch was blocked (about.fb.com not resolvable in this session), so only the search-result title/URL slug was seen. Exact day unknown (URL path shows 2026/11); may fall before the 2026-11-18 window start. Summary is limited to what the title supports.

items.title: Meta post on researchers using its open-weight models in medicine
items.summary_en: An official Meta newsroom post titled 'Researchers Are Using Meta's Open-Weight AI Models to Transform Medicine' appeared in November 2026. It appears to showcase medical research use of Meta's open-weight models; details could not be read.
items.notes: Page not fetched (domain blocked); only title and URL slug seen. Exact day unknown; may predate the window.

coverage_note: Direct access to ai.meta.com and about.fb.com failed (hosts not resolvable); both would need to be allowed in the session's network settings for full verification. Only two official Meta newsroom posts dated November 2026 were identified via search, with unverified exact dates and unread bodies. Nothing from ai.meta.com/blog could be confirmed in the 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-28 window. Older official context, not items: Muse Wonder / Muse Wonder Full announced 2026-10-12 (https://about.fb.com/news/2026/10/introducing-muse-wonder-models/) and the Prometheus supercluster post on Engineering at Meta, 2026-10-19 (https://engineering.fb.com/2026/10/19/data-center-engineering/inside-prometheus-meta-gigawatt-scale-supercluster/). Secondary-only claims, not turned into items because no primary source was found: a Muse Ember model release (~Nov 9), Muse Wonder-trained models extended to Muse/Meta AI users (~Nov 6), Conductor Cloud shutdown (Nov 20), and Santosh Janardhan stepping down from infrastructure leadership (Bloomberg report, Nov 11). A search restricted to official domains found no mention of Muse Ember, so it is unverified.
